title: Serialize agency statement collection capacity and voiding across distinct receipts
description: Close statement-side financial capacity and status race using existing shared statement guard. AgencyServiceFeeCollectionAllocationService.CreateAsync currently begins transaction and locks ReceiptId only, then reads statement totals and existing allocations; two different receipt locks do not serialize the shared StatementId budget. StatementService.VoidAsync does not coordinate collection creation. Acquire shared statement row lock within allocation create/void in a globally consistent order with existing receipt locks, re-read both entities and active allocation sums, and reject statement void while effective collection allocations remain (explicitly void those allocation evidences first). Preserve original shared receipt budget across order/invoice/agency allocations, per-statement/receipt row limits, duplicate rules and all scope/currency/owner checks. Do not lock receipt rows from statement void unless needed; avoid new lock inversion. Review other callers of statement/receipt guards before implementation. Preserve existing current identity/menu/customer scope and explicit source ownership; recheck in locked authoritative state without new grants. Reuse relational transaction/row-lock patterns from existing business services, ensure deterministic documented lock order and safe nested transaction handling. No schema/migration, microservice, new database, implicit fee calculation or accounting/receipt posting. Clear failed tracked changes on rejection as existing business patterns require; no partial state/rows/audit/snapshots. Historical reads and void evidence retained, no deletion/backfill of snapshots. Adapt necessary original fixtures genuinely with original assertions intact. All logs/TRX under .ai/logs/<task>, original failures retained. Mandatory true two-independent-connection SQL race tests using barriers/controlled ordering, never timing sleeps alone; fresh dedicated GUID NEWERP_AUTOTEST only, no drop/reset/reuse/production. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Different receipts allocating same recorded statement serialize on shared statement budget lock; no over-allocation, duplicate active pair or limit bypass. Same receipt cross-family budget locking remains, and currency/customer ownership never changes. Re-read authoritative status/amount/sums under locks before one evidence insert.

Statement void and allocation create/void share statement lock: a statement with live collection evidence cannot be voided; after explicit allocation void retains snapshots/audit, statement may follow existing void rules. Concurrent allocation/statement void produces one valid serialized ordering, no active allocation referencing newly voided statement. Deterministic receipt/statement lock order documented and used consistently, rollback leaves all evidence unchanged.

Mandatory genuine isolated independent-connection races cover two receipts one remaining statement capacity, allocation versus statement void, allocation void versus parent void and same-receipt agency/order/invoice budgets; exactly one capacity winner and conserved sums/status/audit. Test denied authority/ownership/currency and explicit void-release flow, run original receipt/agency collection/statement SQL regressions plus safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: AgencyServiceFeeCollectionAllocationService.CreateAsync:93-97 starts transaction and locks only receipt, then statement sums:120; VoidAsync:250-254 locks only receipt. StatementService.VoidAsync:474-494 freezes void status without coordinating active agency allocations. Receipt lock protects shared receipt but not parallel different receipts for one statement. Existing ERP-350/378 protections are receipt-side; no statement-budget lock task found. These routes lack common statement serialization pending520.
